apostolicCandidateReview: Contact sheet inspected Saul conversion, Stephen, Paul first journey, Jerusalem council, Philippi, Thessalonica/Athens/Corinth, Ephesus, Jerusalem arrest and Felix/Festus/Agrippa. Conversion Saul is a younger adult; later portraits require independent full-size continuity approval if used. Ephesus foreground workers are not automatically Paul. No new image uses these faces.
otherNamedPeople: Paul/Saul, Apollos, Cephas/Peter, Barnabas, Timothy, Sosthenes, Chloe, Crispus, Gaius, Stephanas, James, Aquila, Priscilla, Fortunatus and Achaicus are mentioned in this letter. None is portrayed. Mary, Joseph, John the Baptist and Stephen are not newly portrayed. Prior Mary/Joseph/disciples inventory is inherited from reviewed Matthew; no hidden face/count certified.
newScenes: All sixteen accepted openers are person-free. No person or recurring recognizable group introduced, so no identity image input was required. No parallel branch art used.
superseded: Matthew Transfiguration v1 is not active and was not used as reference.
